title: Sunflower Fighter Poses
description: Four sequential poses of a female character with black hair and sunflower accessories, wearing a yellow and black outfit with a sunflower-themed belt and boots. The character progresses from a standing pose with raised hands, to a dynamic high kick with one leg extended, set against a solid bright green background.
prompt: A four-panel character sheet on a solid bright green background showing the same anime-style female character with short black hair, sunflower hair accessories, and a fierce expression. She wears a yellow frilly dress with black corset belt, black gloves, thigh-high black stockings with circular patterns, and yellow combat boots. The sequence shows her in different action poses: standing with hands raised, another standing variation, performing a high kick, and a final dynamic pose. Cartoon style with bold black outlines and vibrant colors.
